description: Canonical MLS (RFC 9420) ciphersuite vocabulary for v1 KeyPackage cipher_suites[] negotiation and server describe surfaces. Completes the algorithm-agility registry symmetry with digest-suite-registry.json and signature-alg-registry.json.
registry_rules: Schema / describe enum values for MLS ciphersuite fields MUST be generated from active rows' canonical_id.

A ciphersuite not present as an active row MUST fail closed in KeyPackage claim / group negotiation (unsupported ciphersuite); receivers MUST NOT accept unregistered suites even if the underlying MLS library supports them.

New suites (e.g. ChaCha20-Poly1305 for AES-accelerator-less devices, hybrid PQ KEM suites per the encryption-and-audit.md PQ roadmap note) enter additively as new rows with their own profile gates and conformance vectors; the registry is intentionally minimal and does not pre-register suites without an implementation plan.

ciphersuites.security_note: RFC 9420 mandatory-to-implement suite; classical X25519 KEM (not post-quantum; hybrid KEM migration path reserved via ck.aead.hybrid_kem.* namespace and future hardening profile).
